With ATX 3.0 and PCIe Gen 5.0 compatibility, the TITAN GOLD is a must-have for those eyeing the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 40 series GPUs. --> Compliant with The Highest Standards The TITAN GOLD is ATX 3.0 and PCIe Gen 5.0 ready, it has an output port that is compliant with PCIe 5.0, includes native 12+4 pin 12VHPWR connector, which is designed to better communicate with the newer GPUs and delivers up to 600W.    Also, the TITAN GOLD series are fully compliant with Intel PSDG ATX 3.0, the power supply can hold up to 2x total power excursion and 3x GPU power excursion. --> 80 PLUS Gold & Cybenetics Gold Certified TITAN GOLD is extremely efficient and quiet with dual authentic certifications, and a maximum efficiency above 92%. --> Elevate Your System with TITAN GOLD's Premium Components Elevate your setup with TITAN GOLD's premium Japanese capacitors, rated at 105°C and bolstered by dual bulk capacitors. These high-quality components ensure unmatched durability and stability for your system. --> Power Perfected, Unleash Optimal Performance with TITAN GOLD TITAN GOLD's advanced technology, featuring half-bridge, LLC, and Synchronous Rectifier (SR) tech, ensures exceptional signal stability and power efficiency. With DC-to-DC conversion for precise voltage regulation and minimal ripple noise, TITAN GOLD guarantees optimal performance --> Whisper-Quiet Performance with TITAN GOLD Smart Zero Fan Function Experience whisper-quiet operation with the TITAN GOLD's 135mm fluid dynamic bearing (FDB) fan. With zero RPM mode until 15-20% loading, it maintains silence during light usage. At maximum load, the noise level peaks at just 27 dBA at 1400 RPM. --> Cybenetics Ultra Quiet Certified TITAN GOLD earns the prestigious Cybenetics LAMBDA A Certification, verifying its superior noise reduction and efficiency levels through independent testing. --> Compatible with all generations of GPU The TITAN GOLD series provide various I/O interfaces, leading to the satisfaction of the power supply not only for the new generation 40 series GPU, but all generations from AMD and NVIDIA. --> Reliable & Safe Equipped with industrial level of power protection, including all six protections mechanisms to ensure stable and safe system operation. Plus 10 year-warranty to guarantee long-term reliable use.
